question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '–' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

1125 × 45 ÷ 39 – 17 + 19 = ?
solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

Given the interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged. 
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

Now,

Given e×pression: 1125 × 45 ÷ 39 – 17 + 19

After replacing the symbols with their meanings:

⇒ 1125 ÷ 45 × 39 + 17 − 19

Perform operations according to BODMAS:

⇒ **1125 ÷ 45**__ × 39 + 17 − 19

⇒ __**25 × 39**__ + 17 − 19

⇒ __**975 + 17**__ − 19

⇒ __**992 − 19**__

⇒ 973

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
